verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at workable.readme.io (HTTP 200, with a Workable Documentation index). Per-page markdown versions of the docs are also served (e.g. generate-an-access-token.md), and they point agents to the llms index, giving agents a direct, machine-friendly entry point. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and no first-party guidance describing how agents should consume llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://workable.readme.io/llms.
You can subscribe to an event and Workable will notify you when it's triggered.
